rule: Cloud methods are explicitly selected Node-only accounts. Saving, listing and selecting defaults never resolve SDK credentials, probe selected paths, invoke bindings or send requests. Secrets live only in the selected member's keyStore; profiles, paths, regions, project/location and binding names are non-secret metadata. Inference uses only the selected account and model provider. Cloud status is configured readiness, not live authorization.

ownership.nativeEndpoint: Stock skipAuth placeholder-SigV4-signs the device-internal loopback hop; the per-request kit forwarder validates that placeholder and strips signing/hop headers before fixed-target HTTP1 egress. Supplied key/bearer/profile is refused before IPC. Upstream flow remains present.
